body:
# About Cross Tech Edu — your engineering team in Vietnam

Cross Tech Edu is a software outsourcing company based in Hanoi, Vietnam, delivering web, mobile app, backend, cloud and AI development for clients in Japan, Korea and Europe. Your engineering team, based in Vietnam — two-week sprints, 12-month code warranty.

## E-E-A-T: experience, expertise, authoritativeness, trustworthiness
- **Experience:** Built products for Vingroup (VinWonders), GMO ReTech (GMO賃貸DX), Zuellig Pharma (EZ Rx) and many small businesses across Vietnam and Japan.
- **Expertise:** Next.js, React, Laravel, Flutter, React Native, Node, Go, .NET, PostgreSQL, AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, LLM integration and RAG.
- **Authoritativeness:** Long-term technology partners Twendee Soft, JVB Corp, ITED, VFast Soft and Bfast VN work with our engineering team.
- **Trustworthiness:** 12-month code warranty after handover, 4-hour response SLA, contracts with no minimum term, cancel with 15 days' notice.

## Pricing at a glance
Dedicated developers from 300 USD per developer per month. Fixed-price projects from 39 USD. Detailed quote within 48 hours.

## CTA
Book a free 30-minute consultation or request a detailed quote within 48 hours.

## Internal links
[See pricing](/en/pricing-sme/) · [Web & mobile outsourcing](/en/outsourcing-web-mobile-small-business-hanoi/) · [Book a 30-minute call](#contact) · [Blog](/en/blog/)
